content:
Apple today released the beta 5 of iOS 27 along with related updates, but the company also unexpectedly released a second batch of betas, including iOS 26.6.1, macOS 26.6.2, and more.

The beta versions of iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 are now officially available.

If you've been installing Apple's beta software, you have two options today.

After three weeks of waiting, iOS 27 beta 5 has finally arrived, as part of Apple's summer preparations for the next major software release.

However, Apple has also just released a new batch of beta versions for iOS 26 and related updates.

Beta 1 of iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 is now available.

Apple rarely provides beta versions for such minor software updates. Typically, the company pushes out these small updates directly without prior notice.

It's possible that these versions are replacing the larger updates previously expected as iOS 26.7. Either way, Apple clearly felt the need to release them as betas before making them publicly available.

iOS 26.6.1 and related versions are expected to contain only security updates and bug fixes. If we spot any specific changes, we'll let you know.

A reminder: if you've already upgraded your iPhone to the iOS 27 beta, you won't see the option to install iOS 26.6.1. This version is only for devices still running iOS 26.

Are you still on iOS 26? Have you found anything different in the iOS 26.6.1 beta? Let us know in the comments.
